claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi release is v3.263.0 (2026-09-16) per the license table and section; the at-a-glance table lists v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.3 (2026-09-16); the at-a-glance table lists v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.270.0 (2026-09-17); the at-a-glance table lists v2.268.0 (2026-09-02).
Azure Bicep latest stable release is v0.47.16 (2026-09-08); the at-a-glance table still lists v0.46.1 (2026-07-30).
Latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0 (2026-08-26).
Latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1 (2026-09-15); the at-a-glance table still lists v2.4.0 (2026-08-20).
Latest stable OpenTofu release is v1.12.6 (2026-08-19).
GitHub stars: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k, measured 2026-09-21.
Among dedicated IaC tools Terraform is the most-starred, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources; Pro is $400/month with 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources; Enterprise is custom-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then costs roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
